title: Unnormalized isomorphism of algebraic relative dualizing objects
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a flat finitely presented homomorphism of commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Put $B=A\otimes_RA$, with coprojection $p_1:A\to B$, $a\mapsto a\otimes1$, and let $A$ be a $B$-module via multiplication. Let $M,N\in D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be pseudo-coherent over $A$ [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Assume each has finite Tor amplitude over $R$, meaning that for $T=M,N$ there are integers $a_T\le b_T$ such that $H^i(T\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}Q)=0$ for every $R$-module $Q$ and $i\notin[a_T,b_T]$. Compute derived tensor using flat resolutions and derived Hom using injective resolutions, as in [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-point ringed site. Suppose $R\operatorname{Hom}_B(A,M\otimes_{A,p_1}^{\mathbf L}B)$ and $R\operatorname{Hom}_B(A,N\otimes_{A,p_1}^{\mathbf L}B)$ are each isomorphic to $A$ in $D(B)$. Then there exists an isomorphism $M\cong N$ in $D(A)$. No choice of diagonal generator and no compatibility with a chosen generator is part of this conclusion.
